title: eat shit & die 168
author: bpatrick
html: I go back to school Monday. I better start busting my ass to get some comics done. More comic-productive in ’11!
postClass: post-594 post type-post status-publish format-standard hentry category-eatshitanddie uentry post-comic postonpage-1 odd post-author-bpatrick

comments.author: bryan
comments.html:
i LOVE your comics, especially es&d. your commentary is always spot on, the humor is great: very sardonic and dark. BUT i think if you had a regular update schedule and maybe reorganized the comics (so that the prev/next buttons would go to the next in the series and not the next one you updated or something along those lines) i think you could have a really really successful webcomic =)
sincerely,
a fan
p.s. this is coming from someone who has no idea what hes talking about so take the advice with a grain of salt

comments.author: Winston Rowntree
comments.html: ^ I totally agree, for what it’s worth. Well, okay, i’m not one to talk about regular update schedules, but the other stuff i fully endorse!

comments.author: b.patrick
comments.html: Thanks for the advice guys!! I always appreciate suggestions and even complaints. I’m going to work on organizing the previous/next to always refer to one category at a time. I think that’s a great idea. I’d love to have a regular update schedule but right now I don’t think it’s possible without the quality suffering. I’d absolutely love to have a really really successful webcomic but ….(refer to normal curve in “About” section).

comments.author: David
comments.html:
Let me add another big YAY for akimbocomics (love eat shit & die). Since I’ve discovered it I read it (my diet consists of two webcomics only, by the way).
Bryan’s suggestion is a sensible one though, I totally agree.
Anyways, thanks and cheers to you!
And for the time being, we can use “categories” and our browsers’ back button to navigate through some specific series … (sorry if it was obvious!)

comments.author: emulsifier
comments.html:
Previous/next now should stay in category. Comment if something is screwed up. I am working on restoring first/last links. The old ones didn’t stay in category either, so I am trying to figure out how to make them do that. (They are gone until I can figure that out)

**edit, nevermind still working on prev/next links**
***edit, ok prev/next links should now work correctly, Brian check your e-mail***

comments.author: Robert Thom
comments.html: ES&D consistently amazes me. The fact that you aren’t more popular is a fault of humanity in general, and not your work.

comments.author: Jonny Paycheck
comments.html: Now all we need is an Onan section :3 Doing good work b and emu.

comments.author: Anonymous
comments.html: Nice to see the world through the eyes of a guy going about his things in day to day life. Really appreciate the random hot women in the corners of your panels. Makes me feel like I’m walking down the street checking out women all in the comfort of my computer chair, dressing gown and coffee mug.
